description:
The Federal Correctional Complex at Butner, NC is requisitioning 9 brand name or equal Koolaire KDP0500A Ice Makers and 9 brand name or equal Manitowoc SPA312 Ice Dispensers. This requirement will be awarded following FAR Overhaul 12.201-1(c)(2). Following this presolicitation, FCC Butner will solicit quotations from at least 3 sources and award based of off lowest price techincally acceptable. The anticipated date of award is April 10, 2026. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.

Products proposed must meet atleast the following qualifications to be eligible for award:

The Ice Maker must have the following qualities:

  • approximately 30" W and 24" D to fit the accompanying dispenser.
  • production capacity around 502 lb/24 hours
  • no digital screens
  • no water cooled condenser
  • smudge & fingerprint resistant stainless like finish
  • dice size cubes
  • 115V
  • Energy Star certified
  • at least industry standard warranty

The Ice Dispenser must have the following qualities:

  • vending ice dispenser
  • approximately 30" W x 32" D to fit the accompanying ice maker
  • approximately 180-lb capacity for dice ice
  • bucket filling
  • stainless steel exterior
  • 115V
  • at least industry standard warranty
